authorization.temporal_order: This result-free declaration lands first. The producer, sampled record, regenerating checker, and sampled CI row belong to a later commit.

r3c_trigger.selection_role: These are the R3c point-estimate support cells, selected after R3c and therefore not a prospective test of which cells are extremal. Their coordinates and all R3d endpoints are frozen before any R3d sample is drawn.

estimand.name: qr3_direction_on_preregistered_r3c_point_support
estimand.question: After adding only the frozen geometric midpoints inside the inherited conservative intervals, is the minimum possible mapping spread on R3c's widest point-support cell strictly greater than the maximum possible instance spread on R3c's narrowest point-support cell?
estimand.directional_scope: A strict separation establishes that a mapping spread is larger than an instance spread on these preregistered supports and therefore establishes the positive QR3 direction within the frozen two-instance exact-tier boundary.
estimand.asymmetric_limitation: Failure to separate cannot establish the opposite QR3 direction because R3d targets R3c's point-support cells rather than refining all 187 cells entering the global extrema. Every non-separating outcome is indeterminate_after_refinement.
estimand.evidence_tier_basis: Oracle-reference benchmark comparison with heuristic Monte Carlo search uncertainty; not a finite-sample energy certificate, device-noise simulation, or hardware result.

refinement.endpoint_rule: For each target cell, sample every global geometric midpoint strictly inside that cell's inherited conservative endpoint interval and no other endpoint.
refinement.ceiling_policy: No endpoint above 65536 is licensed. R3d refines resolution between existing endpoints and is not a wider-grid search.
refinement.parent_evidence_policy: The two parent records and their endpoint decisions are immutable and read-only. R3d does not redraw, overwrite, pool replicas with, or reinterpret a parent endpoint. It begins from each parent's already-conservative interval.
refinement.new_evidence_policy: Every declared midpoint receives its own R3d exploratory and confirmatory blocks. Only the confirmatory block can tighten an inherited interval; exploration is reported as a protocol diagnostic and cannot select or suppress an endpoint.
refinement.interval_update_rule: Start from the inherited conservative (lower, upper] endpoint interval. A non-marginal confirmed R3d failure raises lower to max(lower, endpoint); a non-marginal confirmed R3d pass lowers upper to min(upper, endpoint). An environment-marginal R3d endpoint is reported but does not tighten either side. Parent intervals may only narrow, never widen.
refinement.invalid_refinement_rule: If an endpoint is missing, a required statistic is non-finite, the combined non-marginal decisions are nonmonotone, or the updated lower is not strictly below the updated upper, that support is invalid and the only allowed readout is indeterminate_after_refinement.

protocol.seed_derivation: For exploratory and confirmatory sampling use numpy.SeedSequence(root, spawn_key=(target_cell_index, replica_index)); larger R3d endpoints reuse the prefix shots of the same cell/phase/replica stream. For bootstrap use spawn_key=(target_cell_index, phase_index, endpoint_index, estimator_index). Target-cell order is the array order above. Parent samples are never part of an R3d stream.
protocol.pass_rule: A new endpoint passes only when all 100 confirmatory solves succeed and the one-sided 95% bootstrap upper confidence bound on replica RMSE is at most 1.6 mHa.
protocol.environment_marginal_rule: When the confirmatory RMSE upper bound is finite and abs(UCB - 1.6 mHa) / 1.6 mHa is at most 0.10, label that R3d endpoint environment-marginal and do not use it to tighten either interval side.

future_readout.mapping_support_minimum_formula: max(mapping-cell lower costs) / min(mapping-cell upper costs), clamped below at 1
future_readout.instance_support_maximum_formula: max(instance-cell upper costs) / min(instance-cell lower costs)
future_readout.positive: qr3_mapping_spread_larger_on_preregistered_support, if and only if both supports are valid and mapping_support_minimum is strictly greater than instance_support_maximum
future_readout.otherwise: indeterminate_after_refinement, including overlap, equality, marginal-only non-resolution, missing evidence, nonmonotonicity, or an invalid interval

reporting_contract.scope: one accuracy target, one candidate family, two eight-qubit instances, the two frozen R3c point-support comparisons, and their named illustrative device cards; not an instance-independent mapping claim

claim_boundary: This configuration contains historical R3c support coordinates and inherited parent endpoint intervals, but no R3d sample, endpoint classification, refined interval, refined spread, execution stamp, or QR3 classification. A later record may report only the seven frozen within-grid endpoint cells under the declared 30+100 protocol. It may establish the positive QR3 direction on the preregistered supports or remain indeterminate; it may not report a negative QR3 direction, widen the grid, reselect an extremal cell, or alter either parent record.
